elena (product): Quick sync — we need a concrete onboarding checklist that covers SOC2 evidence, BYOK handshake traces, and a repeatable evidence-export runbook. who can take point?
elena (product): The product ask is testable gates + minimal rollout criteria so sales can promise it to pilots.
sam (eng): I can own the tech checklist. question: what minimal fields do we need per audit event?
jay (security): Minimal schema: timestamp, tenant_id, actor_id, action, resource_id, model_id/version, request_meta (input size, token counts), keystore_event (if any), request_id, parent_request_id. tag each event with retention_tier.
maria (legal): Also include chain_of_custody_id and export_manifest_hash. auditors want a signed manifest and a simple human README for packages.
hao (sre): For testing I'll spin up a synthetic tenant that exercises: key create/rotate/delete, model calls, admin changes, and a legal-hold snapshot. I'll need a KMS emulation flag for staging.
devex (devex): I'll build a small validator CLI: 
```
redwood-evidence validate --manifest manifests/manifest.json --signatures certs/
```
it should surface missing fields and signature mismatches.
ops-bot: :information_source: Current evidence spec (internal staging): https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/evidence-spec
jay (security): Proposed launch gates (top-level):
- Gate 1: Event fidelity — for a 24h synthetic run, sampled events must have <=0.5% missing required fields.
- Gate 2: Exportability — automated API export produces complete evidence.zip (manifest + logs + certs + runbook) within SLA.
- Gate 3: BYOK handshake observability — every keystore operation logged and linked to evidence package.
- Gate 4: Forensic retrieval — given an event id, whole trace chain can be retrieved; warm <5m, cold <2h.
- Gate 5: Legal manifests — manifest is signed (HSM-backed) and includes checksum + timestamp.
maria (legal): For Gate 5 we need an explicit statement in onboarding consent about what exports include and export retention behavior. legal will draft text.
elena (product): Good. owners: Sam + Jay take Gate1/2/3, Hao takes Gate4 infra, Maria owns Gate5 text. I'll coordinate rollout criteria and pilot acceptance.
sam (eng): Tech acceptance steps (Gate 1):
1) run synthetic workload generator for 24h with predefined seed
2) ingest and index pipeline runs
3) run comparator: expected_events.json vs emitted_events.json (sample up to 20k)
4) assert missing_rate <= 0.5% and no malformed schema entries

sam (eng): Gate 2 export steps:
1) POST /v1/compliance/export {tenant, window, type:evidence}
2) receive job_id and poll /v1/jobs/{id}
3) when ready, download evidence.zip and run validator CLI
4) E2E time <= 48h (hosted target: <=8h)
jay (security): Gate 3 BYOK checks:
1) verify keystore ops are present in both logs and manifest
2) ensure key fingerprints and escrow instructions included
3) ensure no plaintext keys in exports

devex (devex): I'll add a console flow sample and a one-click export button for pilots, plus the CLI validator. also a sample playbook PDF in package.
hao (sre): Notes on infra and cost: exports can be large. propose hard cap 100GB per export; if exceeded auto-chunk and provide paginated manifests. also require explicit approval for >100GB exports.
elena (product): Keep redaction out of scope for initial launch. if customer requests redaction, it must be an auditable separate task — schedule post-pilot.
jay (security): Agreed. redaction is a policy layer with its own audit trail — don't mix with primary evidence.
maria (legal): We'll need two sample evidence packages for auditors: one normal and one with a legal-hold snapshot. legal will prepare audit-readme and consent copy.
sam (eng): Failure modes and rollback: document partial-export states, retry semantics, and how to mark an export as incomplete in UI. canary rollout must have automatic fallback to smaller model variant for capacity spikes.
h ao (sre): typo in name above — fixing: I (hao) will add runbook sections for chunking, retry, storage TTL, and escalation steps.
hao (sre): I'll also provide env toggles for KMS emulation: REDWOOD_KMS_MODE={real,emulate} and a sample escrow webhook sink.
devex (devex): Timeline suggestion:
- Thu EOD: draft checklists (sam/jay)
- Mon: infra + synthetic tenant ready (hao)
- Tue: validator CLI + sample playbook (devex)
- Wed: tabletop with sales/SE/legal + runbook walkthrough
- 2-week: pilot export with first customer
elena (product): Sounds good. small ask: include a short SLA blurb we can show sales: expected export time, size caps, evidence integrity guarantees, and escalation contact.
jay (security): I'll draft an SLA blurb that highlights signed manifests and HSM-backed timestamps.
maria (legal): I'll circulate the onboarding consent language and the auditor README by Tue.
sam (eng): I'll post the initial checklists and a lightweight test harness repo link when done.
devex (devex): One more thing — CLI will have a `--verify-signature` flag and an output that maps manifest entries to UI links for quick reviewer navigation.
elena (product): Thanks everyone. owners: sam/jay/hao/devex/maria. I'll collate deliverables into the pilot acceptance doc and ping sales.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Created task: #COM-17456 - Pilot evidence export runbook (assigned to elena)
jay (security): tiny follow-up: ensure export manifest records schema version and product build id so auditors can map events to code versions.
sam (eng): good call. I'll add manifest.schema_version and product_build_id fields.
elena (product): Meeting adjourned. I'll update the roadmap card and set a 1-hour tabletop invite. thanks!
